summary: Date shown is the November 4, 2021 announcement, not the discovery or recovery day. Skeletal remains found by a hiker in Skeleton Gulch (west side of Rocky Mountain National Park) in mid-August 2020 were recovered in summer 2021 with FBI Evidence Response Team assistance; believed to be Rudi Moder, 27, of West Germany, missing since a Feb-1983 ski-mountaineering trip over Thunder Pass; closes a ~38-year cold case.
location: Skeleton Gulch, west side of Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; FBI Evidence Response Team
notes: DATE REQUIRES REVIEW BEFORE PROMOTION: 2021-11-04 is the NPS news-release date only. The source places discovery in mid-August 2020 and further search/recovery in summer 2021 without an exact day. Do not interpret the stored date as the incident date. Identification through dental records was inconclusive; NPS described the remains as believed to be Moder's. Source reviewed 2026-11-20. NPS RMNP news release dated 2021-11-04.
